prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet interaction visual tips screen: Add a dedicated visual guide screen before finishing onboarding to demonstrate how to click, drag, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"show_step_counter": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_interaction_tips", "home_intro"], "new_pet_interaction_tips": {"headline": "Interacting with Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Drag to move your pet, right-click for quick actions, or double-click to chat.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:pet_guide", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Account sync reassurance panel on sign-in: Redesign sign-in options panel with clear text confirming account progress and pet data persistence.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "text", "text": "Sign in to save your pet and progress across sessions", "style": "emphasis", "role": "sign_in_options"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Continue with Account", "action": "next", "style": "large", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after adoption certificate: Move sign-in screen to appear right after adoption certificate confirmation, before the setup waiting screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo validation check sub-flow: Insert a dedicated photo verification screen to confirm quality and lighting before pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload front-facing photos with clear lighting."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_check": {"headline": "Verifying Photo Quality", "body": "Checking face alignment and resolution for optimal pet generation...", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Clear focus, front face visible, good lighting", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [adoption, layout] Checklist layout for photo upload screen: Switch the photo upload screen layout to a checklist format highlighting recommended photo guidelines.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "checklist", "hint": "Follow requirements for best pet generation results."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop launch info on waiting screen: Add system launch updates and tips to the waiting screen detailing desktop overlay setup progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Overlay", "body": "Preparing graphics rendering engine and desktop overlay settings...", "tip_delay_seconds": 8}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Clear path option copy revision: Update headline and body on the choose_path screen to succinctly differentiate preset selection from custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Setup Style", "body": "Pick an existing pet companion for instant fun, or build a custom pet using your own photos."}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop shortcut hint on home intro: Display a helpful hint on the home_intro screen explaining key shortcuts to bring hidden pets to the foreground.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to reveal your pet if it gets obscured by other applications."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Free toy item unlock incentive: Add an incentive text callout on the adoption certificate screen offering a free starter accessory item upon completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Bonus: Claim a free pet accessory upon certificate completion!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for choose path: Redesign choose_path using a spotlight layout with large choice cards for path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Choose standard pet or custom avatar", "style": "large", "role": "path_options"}]}}}

verdicts.reason: Adding an interaction guide screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning sign-in copy and layout inside onboarding is allowed while maintaining functionality.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed in rule 4 and keeps all steps intact.
Inserting a photo verification sub-flow step during onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while maintaining its core job is allowed.
Updating waiting screen copy to show setup progress preserves its job of showing the pet is being made.
Updating copy on choose_path screen clearly retains both adoption and custom pet options.
Adding shortcut hints to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions a free pet accessory bonus, violating the rule against mentioning free extras or gifts.
Redesigning choose_path layout maintains the job of offering standard adoption and custom avatar creation.
